rationale: The agent appears to have unilaterally canceled the order and stated a refund was processing without authenticating the user, without confirming the action, and without attempting the user’s preferred sequence (try split payment; if not, identify/cancel most expensive item; if not, switch items to cheapest; only then cancel order). No tool calls are shown (no user or order lookup, no get_order_details, no cancel_pending_order). This violates the policy’s requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, confirm every order-changing action before taking it, and avoid unsupported statements. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
